tools.name: series-core
tools.description: Built-in time-series helpers (resample, slope, peaks, phases, zones, parseCsvLoose, toSeconds) and a generic min/max/mean analyzer for any Session.

tools.name: pose-metrics
tools.description: Generic body-landmark metrics: joint angles, torso angle, visibility, motion energy, jitter, bbox, dominant frequency, cycle counting.

tools.description: Garmin-style running CSV with timestamp, elapsed_s, distance_m, speed_mps, pace_min_km, heart_rate_bpm, cadence_spm, altitude_m columns parsed into a running Session.

tools.name: running-profile
tools.description: Analyzes a running session from speed, heart rate, cadence and elevation series: pace, speed variability, cadence, heart-rate zones and climb.
